help.title: Help and support
help.q1: Why are no ads playing on my tablet?
help.a1: Check that the tablet is switched on and connected to the internet. If it still does not play, report an issue under “Advertisement not playing”.
help.q2: When will I get my payment?
help.a2: Open Earnings to see what is pending, being processed and released. Only “Released” has been sent to you.
help.q3: Why is my earning different from what I expected?
help.a3: Earnings depend on ads that played fully. See the per-ad earnings in Earnings. If it still looks wrong, report an “Earnings mismatch”.
help.q4: I did not get the OTP. What should I do?
help.a4: Wait for the timer, then tap Resend OTP. Check that your mobile number is correct and has signal.
help.q5: How do I change my language?
help.a5: Use the language buttons at the top of the screen, or open Profile and choose a language.
help.contactHint: For urgent problems, call or email us. For everything else, report an issue so we can track it.
